# Machines & Cloud

> AI website chat for home-service businesses. Give customers answers about your services, area and fees while your team works. Keep the job details and conversation together for the next callback.

## The customer experience

Visitors can ask follow-up questions in English or Spanish, describe a problem and leave their contact details. The front desk uses information supplied by the business and can collect a preferred visit window. The business reviews the request and confirms the visit.

The owner workspace brings customer requests, conversations, business answers and owner-maintained availability together. Customer records can be exported as CSV. The examples on the website use fictional shops and customer details; optional voice practice is a demonstration.

## Getting started

Create a front desk and test it free, with no card required. Verify your email, add your business information and try the questions customers ask. The workspace includes a website installation guide, a review checklist and the applicable chat allowance before activation.

Phone answering, text messaging and Google Calendar can be selected as connection interests during setup. Selection saves a preference. The workspace shows actual connection status, required authorizations and activation checks. For a specific software connection, confirm the supported scope with Machines & Cloud before relying on it.

## Service plans

Coverage at $99/month and Follow-through at $249/month are phone-and-text plan previews. Enterprise pricing is tailored to the requirements discussed. Plan selection records an interest; the service, included usage and paid terms are confirmed with the owner before any paid service starts.

## Customer care

The business supplies its service, pricing and urgent-contact instructions. It confirms visits and follows up on requests. Customers needing an immediate emergency response should use the business’s direct emergency contact or the appropriate emergency service.
